title: Machine execution fault policy
applies: Engine CLI errors and host recovery; never infer from ACP prose

sections.applies: Engine CLI wire emission only; never ACP rewriting
sections.text: Emit the already sealed complete tool reply through bounded UTF-8-safe writes without changing its text or print newline. An output write/flush/encoding/short-write failure has delivery UNVERIFIED even if the Engine commit succeeded: a prefix may already be visible. Do not automatically print the full reply again or repeat business. Preserve the complete echo, receipt and original failure; use the existing actual-human, bound reply-only recovery path. A successful local write/flush does not prove Provider receipt. Automatic recovery of pre-emission projection failures retains its existing single-attempt and evidence rules.

sections.applies: alpha155 new accepted receipts with return_transition, manual reply recovery only
sections.text: After one actual human recovery decision, a sealed original segment's host return may explain state drift only when its paired start/return, formal ticket and the restored full recovery hash verify. Restore only the original state/lifecycle/exit_evidence/context_resume fields for comparison, not execution; all other state remains exact. Emit a historical read-only notice and original reply reference, never the old next_plan or ticket. The permit binds the current recovery hash; any later change stops before consumption. Current continuation uses next_node without the old ticket and all existing guards. Old receipts without this capsule keep strict rules; no backfilled authority, child creation, physical-exit claim or business replay.
